title: When you want to eat some new crispy fun breakfast, then make this breakfast which is to be made very easy. Nashta
description: When you want to eat some new crispy fun breakfast, then make this breakfast which is to be made very easy. Nashta

asr.full_text: Today, we will see a very simple and easy way to make Tacos and all the ingredients needed to make the Tacos, this is usually there at home First, we will prepare its dough 1 cup All-purpose flour as well as 1 cup Wheat Flour if you want you can use only these either with Flour or if you want it to be healthy you can also use wheat flour now add salt I used about 1 TBSP of salt you can add salt as per your taste add 2 TBSP of oil I have used refined oil Add 2 big spoon of Oil Make sure of using any oil with strong flavour Keep adding small bowl of water to knead into a soft dough so, add water and knead well So, its really easy and fast This is my recipe of Taco It's too simple and kneading the dough well The recipe of Takus is very simple and simple as possible so you have no difficulty to make it when dough will start to stick to surface Then you have to constantly press this for 2-3 minutes so it gets smooth now this dough is ready let us cover it and let it rest for 10-15 mins and till that time we'll prepare the rest now we'll take a pan 2-3 tbsp oil and after the oil gets heated, we'll add one spring onion and i have cut this long it will fry till it turns brown And I have cut it long into slices Now we have to fry this onion until it becomes little brown If you want then you can add some Salt in this time So that this onion gets brown very fast This way frying the onion gives it flavour So that it gets really well fried Now the onion has turned brown So now what we will do is, we will pull this onion out of the pan And the extra Oil and cut it to half. You can also place it in this pan. We have to roast bread in this pan after some time. Now we have Take 4 to 5 potato, And grate them first. Potato we are grating so that we don't crack any piece of it. I have grated all the potatoes Now we have to add fried onions Now with this I will be adding 1 tbsp of Chillion Flakes If you do not have Chillion Flakes you can use Red Chili Powder If you want to make it at your home So take a little Dried red Chilli powder and Grind it in a mixi So make Chilli Flakes at home... Then you simply Take Dry Red Chilli and Grind it in Mixie And you Chilli Flakes are ready... quantity of Chilli Flakes can be set according to your taste Now I am adding half teaspoon of Black Pepper Powder Now for a tasty taste I am adding 1 to 4 teaspoon of Chaat Masala put 1 cup of chat masala 1 quarter teaspoon you can add some lemon juice instead if you want after that, add salt as per taste I have used a teaspoon do notice that we are not adding much salt because we have already used chat masala at last, will add coriander After adding dhaniya and coriander leaves... Mix it thoroughly. As you can see here. Our stuffing is now ready to plate. Our dough is now resting for about 10-15 mins. Let's knead it again and make 2 equal parts of dough. You have to divide dough in 2 at a time. Now spread some flour or wheat flour on flat surface of any rolling board. You need to divide dough in two equal portions On flat surfaces, or on your tableware... You need to use all you got dough or some all purpose flour Keep the dough on it and roll it Using a knife we divide it into two equal portions This much dough is sufficient for 10-12 tacos Keep the dough on your table and give it a ball shape. On a rolling board sprinkle some maida or wheat flour. We will place the ball on the dough which we need to dust in the flour. Then roll the dough using a rolling pin. Remember that you should neither have to roll it really thick and also thin one. You can see that I have roll it and its thickness is same. Similarly make other rotis with this method as well. Once all the rotis are ready then we will melt them. For that you have to heat a pan, and then you have to melt To Grill you must heat pan with full heat and grill in high flame Currently, we have not grill this well we will grill in real time because this we are going to grill in another time Now you turn this pan in high flame and grill and cook till the time when there no bubbles on the bread Once your is ready to do this then we will take it out and you also have to roast the other pieces like this Now what you have to do is put some tomato ketchup onto the bread You can use red chili sauce or or if you like mayonnaise then you will use it We spread tomato ketchup evenly over the bread Now our stuffing of the potato has to be placed on one side of the bread Spread it evenly You don't have to spread potato stuffing on all the one of the bread slices and spread it evenly Do not spread the stuffing all over the bread Now use one side of the bread Now over the stuffing add a little bit of cheese I've added mozzrella cheese you can also use the processed cheese and the quantity of the cheese you can also add or remove And place it on the bread must also be lightly pressed to stick to it. At last, tacos are almost ready. Similarly, you will need to shape all the tacos as well and keep them ready. You will have to roast the tacos till they look nice. This type of taco is used for serving and serve these at the end of cooking. Now you can see how I have made the tacos. I am adding some Butter. You may replace Butter with Oil and use Butter only if required. Once Butter is melted you must add the tacos into the grill. We will roast on Slow Flame so that they turn an even flavor keep the tacos on plate when the butter is melted we are going to cook them on slow flame to make them crispy If you are cooking them on high flame it will be browned but not crispy so if you want to make your tacos super crispy then cook them on slow or medium flame after a few minutes flip it and also cook the other side of the chicken we have to bake it on another side when both the sides are baked properly so you can bake it using two spoon OK, We have made 2 sides well, Now take the out from pan So now its ready to eat like this we all ready the other tacos like this we all ready the other tacos this taco looks very fresh, but its not much to make if you can make this in one go so be sure to try this recipe and share you experience do comment in the comments now we gonna see another great recipe and making it is really easy and it tastes delicious To make it, Take 2 cups of Dung Beans This is raw, I didn't boil them put them into mixer and grind it you shouldn't grind them very fine you should grind it a little coarse to making it as its first step. But we need even more to make it as even and soft as possible. As you can see that I have finely ground this corn. In a pan or a pan or a tawa now take 2 tbsp of oil. Once the oil is heated evenly we will add 1 finely chopped Onion. We will just keep on frying it till it become golden brown when it become golden we will add 1 tbsp grated ginger then we will add 1 tbsp grated garlic and 2-3 Green Chili we have to fry them for 1 minute we will add Maka's paste And we need to cook them for 1 minute Add the batter we've prepared & cook the batter on medium flame for about 2-3 minutes Once the batter is cooked properly, turn the heat to low Because now we're about to add masalas First we'll add one tsp of Chili Flakes Instead of it you can use Red Chili powder Next we'll add 1 quatet teaspoon Chat Masala If you will take Aamchur Powder in place of Chat Masala then it will be alright and add 1 quatet teaspoon Black Pepper Powder We have to add Salt as per our tastes but you should still remember we have used Chat Masala before that is why please do to add too much salt At last, we'll add Coriander . and mix all of them together once. Stuffing for this is now ready. Let's allow it to cool down completely. Until the time, its cooled down enough, You have to take 5 to 6 boiled potatoes I am using very large potatoes And we will grate these potatoes properly with the help of a Grater This is the reason why we are grating the potatoes So that there would be no big pieces of potato in them One more thing to keep in mind You should use cold potatoes in this recipe The if you are using hot then when you will make the dough Then your dough will be slippery & very soft And to adjust this dough, you have to add many cornstarch or Bread crumbs So in this recipe, you have to use cold potatoes Now the potatoes have been grated, we'll add 1 there's no need to add much salt As we've already used salt in stuffing as well. Stir everything very well. Now add 2 Bread slices and roughly chop the slices to make it into a mixer jar. Now grind it and make the breadcrumbs. I've just grinded it. When to make Bread Crumbs. Now to this I have to grind this a little bit to make Bread crumbs. Here I have grind this and you can see that your Bread crumbs are now ready. Now to this I have to grind this and you can see that your Bread crumbs are now ready. Now to this I have grinder this and you can see that your Bread crumbs are now ready. Now add some bread crumbs to your potato dough. now for the bread you also needs to add some bread crumbs. Now to this I have grind this a mix well too if you feel there is too much bread crumbs in this dough then you can add more bread crumbs for this dough I needed almost half a cup bread crumbs the potato dough is ready for this we will make a chutney to make this chutney take 3 to 4 cloves garlic of your choice then we will add green chilies, peanuts, sugar and salt If you don't use garlic, you may also add ginger After grinding the mixture add lemon juice Then add Coriander leaves Along with coriander leaves, you have to use coriander stem and if you have't have green coriander then you can add capsicum using capsicum will make this chutney look nice and colourful along with that it will also make chutney thick now we will add 2-3 tbsp of water so this chutney gets blend nicely and now blend it and now blend and prepare the chutney while blending, you can also add 2-3 ice cubes to help in changing the color of chutney and here, we've prepared the coriander chutney get some oil in your hands to avoid it sticking in your hands so that it is not sticky and we have to make balls from it Now the ball is ready in the same form and we prepare other pieces in the same way Now we have to make balls from Aloo Dough then we flatten the balls as big as that of Puri Now we flat like poori Add McKay stuffing ball into it Mix well Now put it to middle of the handles As the paste is ready Now prepare another sheet and then also it Now the fry the dough And you have to prepare other patties similarly Now, it's turn for frying For frying, heat the oil very well And fry only 3-4 patties at one time If you are going to fry many patties at one time, Then the temperature of oil will be reduced And the chance for being fried is high As a result, fry only 3-4 of these at once you have to fry these until they are golden brown & crispy so now as you can see that the potatos have become a crisp and golden brown now we'll take them out you can even use tissue a paper towel as well. So here is our hot and delicious Macai Peites will be ready. When you bite, you will know that how crispy are these Makai Peites.
